from pathlib import Path

code='''def transform(grid):
    # Fill background cells enclosed by the colored boundary, using demo fill color.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Flood-fill background from all borders; enclosed background components become 4.
    from collections import deque
    seen=set(); q=deque()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in (0,w-1):
            if g[r][c] != 8: seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))
    for c in range(w):
        for r in (0,h-1):
            if g[r][c] != 8 and (r,c) not in seen: seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and g[nr][nc]!=8 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=8 and (r,c) not in seen: g[r][c]=4
    return g
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'))

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u090/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3ef79b18.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    line=max(set(x for row in g for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(v==x for row in g for v in row) if x!=max(set(x for row in g for x in row), key=lambda y:sum(v==y for row in g for v in row)) else 0)
    # The abundant background is not the drawing; use the rare line color.
    counts={x:sum(v==x for row in g for v in row) for x in set(v for row in g for v in row)}
    bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    colors=[x for x in counts if x!=bg]
    if not colors: return g
    line=max(colors,key=counts.get)
    # Every fully outlined rectangular cell is filled; interior strokes are covered too.
    for r1 in range(h):
        for r2 in range(r1+2,h):
            for c1 in range(w):
                for c2 in range(c1+2,w):
                    if (all(g[r1][c]==line for c in range(c1,c2+1)) and
                        all(g[r2][c]==line for c in range(c1,c2+1)) and
                        all(g[r][c1]==line for r in range(r1,r2+1)) and
                        all(g[r][c2]==line for r in range(r1,r2+1))):
                        for r in range(r1+1,r2):
                            for c in range(c1+1,c2): g[r][c]=4
    return g
'''
